label: title
js: game.hold(true); game.G.autoPause = false; game.step(1); const t = document.getElementById('title'); const out = [...t.querySelectorAll('button, .keys, .touch-hint, .logo')].filter((e) => e.offsetParent).filter((e) => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.left < -1 || r.right > innerWidth + 1 || r.bottom > innerHeight + 1; }).map((e) => e.id || e.className); JSON.stringify({ touch: document.body.classList.contains('touch'), scroll: t.scrollHeight > innerHeight + 2, outside: out })

label: 1P play
js: window.overlaps = () => { const r = (el) => el && el.getBoundingClientRect(); const hit = (a, b) => a && b && a.width && b.width && a.left < b.right - 1 && b.left < a.right - 1 && a.top < b.bottom - 1 && b.top < a.bottom - 1; const vis = (e) => e && getComputedStyle(e).display !== 'none' && getComputedStyle(e).visibility !== 'hidden' && e.getClientRects().length; const kit = ['kit-help-btn', 'kit-lang-btn', 'kit-sound-btn'].map((id) => document.getElementById(id)).filter(vis); const ctrls = [...document.querySelectorAll('#touch .dk, #touch .tb, .box, .ibtn, .bud')].filter((e) => vis(e) && e.offsetParent); const sh = game.world().shape; const bb = [1e9, 1e9, -1e9, -1e9]; const grow = (x, y) => { bb[0] = Math.min(bb[0], x); bb[1] = Math.min(bb[1], y); bb[2] = Math.max(bb[2], x); bb[3] = Math.max(bb[3], y); }; sh.pts.forEach(([x, y]) => { grow(x - 0.3, y - 0.3); grow(x + 0.3, y + 0.3); }); for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) { const L = TZ.shapes.lane(sh.pts, i); grow(L.mid[0] + L.n[0] * 1.6, L.mid[1] + L.n[1] * 1.6); } const [x0, y0] = game.toScreen(bb[0], bb[3]); const [x1, y1] = game.toScreen(bb[2], bb[1]); const area = { left: x0, top: y0, right: x1, bottom: y1, width: x1 - x0, height: y1 - y0 }; const bad = []; for (const k of kit) { for (const c of ctrls) if (hit(r(k), r(c))) bad.push(k.id + ' x ' + (c.dataset.a || c.id || c.className)); if (hit(r(k), area)) bad.push(k.id + ' x tube'); } const tcs = [...document.querySelectorAll('#touch .dk, #touch .tb')].filter((c) => c.offsetParent); for (const c of tcs) { if (hit(r(c), area)) bad.push(c.dataset.a + ' x tube'); for (const d of tcs) if (c !== d && hit(r(c), r(d))) bad.push(c.dataset.a + ' x ' + d.dataset.a); } const boxes = [...document.querySelectorAll('.box, .ibtn, .bud')].filter((e) => vis(e) && e.offsetParent); for (const b of boxes) if (hit(r(b), area)) bad.push((b.id || b.className) + ' x tube'); const small = tcs.map((e) => Math.round(Math.min(r(e).width, r(e).height))); return { touch: document.body.classList.contains('touch'), tube: [Math.round(x0), Math.round(y0), Math.round(x1), Math.round(y1)], pxPerM: +game.G.k.toFixed(1), bad, smallestTap: small.length ? Math.min(...small) : null, scroll: document.documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth + 1 || document.documentElement.scrollHeight > innerHeight + 1 }; }; const all = {}; for (const lv of [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]) { game.start({ level: 'easy', players: 1, go: true, lv }); game.step(1); const o = overlaps(); all[game.world().shape.id] = o.bad.length ? o.bad : 'ok'; all.tap = o.smallestTap; all.pxPerM = o.pxPerM; all.scroll = o.scroll; } game.start({ level: 'easy', players: 1, go: true }); game.step(1); JSON.stringify(all)

label: 2P play
js: const all2 = {}; for (const lv of [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]) { game.start({ level: 'easy', players: 2, go: true, lv }); game.step(1); const o = overlaps(); all2[game.world().shape.id] = o.bad.length ? o.bad : 'ok'; } JSON.stringify(all2)

label: results
js: const w = game.world(); w.players.forEach((p) => (p.lives = 1)); for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) { game.step(3); w.phase = 'play'; w.from = null; game.quiet(); w.zap.inv = 0; game.lane(6); game.critter('jelly', 6, 1); game.step(1.0); } game.step(3); JSON.stringify({ screen: game.state().screen, scroll: document.getElementById('results').scrollHeight > innerHeight + 2 })
